versions.title: Initial release
items: Markdown vaults with folder paths, note tree, and vault switcher
Editor with split/edit/preview, toolbar, autosave, and Ctrl/Cmd+S
Paste/drop images and file attachments with lightbox
Excalidraw whiteboards as first-class notes (maximize, peek, wiki, shares)
Inline board embeds with ![[Whiteboard]] (plain [[Whiteboard]] stays a link)
Search by title/path/body and Jump to note palette (Ctrl/Cmd+O)
Wikilinks (path + unique leaf), cross-vault [[@vault/note]], tags, and backlinks
Focused and full mindmaps; board→note links in References
Rich markdown: Mermaid, KaTeX, highlight, callouts, footnotes, and TOC
Note revision history with side-by-side restore
ZIP import/export with nested folders and images
Note templates (blank, meeting, risk, decision)
Trash with soft-delete and restore; leave shared / delete owned vaults
Checkbox → Myelin tasks (manual push/link; Synapse pulls closed/cancelled)
Password-protected temporary share links (/s/:token)
Send notes: copy or move to another vault from the Share modal
Public wiki (/w/:slug) with vault and per-note visibility
Wiki directory (/w) listing wikis you may open
Vault sharing: Read = wiki only; Edit = vault editor + wiki
Local username/password auth and optional Myelin SSO (linked by email)
Password reset via SMTP; admin settings for registration, SMTP, and users
Optional AI todo suggestions (Ollama or OpenAI) with review/merge before save
Myelin bridge: per-user SSO token or personal API key; manual vault→project link
Theme (light/dark/system + palettes) and UI languages pt/en/es/fr

versions.title: Update i18n implementation and UI localization across the application
items: Introduced a new `synapse-i18n.mdc` file to define localization rules for UI strings in multiple languages (English, European Portuguese, Spanish, French)
Updated various components and pages to utilize i18n for user-visible strings, ensuring consistent language support throughout the application
Enhanced error messages and status notifications to leverage localization, improving user experience for non-English speakers
Refactored existing UI elements to follow the new i18n guidelines, including status messages, template labels, and modal content

versions.title: Implement session expiration handling and enhance task linking functi…
items: Redirect to login when the session expires in the note editor
Ensure Myelin tasks modal correctly links to the Myelin project instead of localhost
Introduce a new `whats-new:generate` script for generating versioned changelogs
Improve task loading performance in the modal by implementing search debounce
Automatically fill the assignee field based on vault settings
Allow users to change the slug of the wiki
Enable exporting notes in static wiki format
Update various components to handle note conflicts and presence notifications
Enhance the UI for better user experience during task management and note editing
